title: Machine capability profile
description: Declares what a host machine allows the devin-* ecosystem tools to do. Fail-closed: absent capabilities mean false, and the default profile is 'corporate'. See docs/capability-profile.md.

profile.description: corporate = fail-closed default; personal must be declared explicitly.

capabilities.description: Allowed capabilities; absent keys are treated as false.

net.outbound.description: May open outbound network connections (beyond what a task explicitly asks for).

net.listener.description: May bind a listening socket (local HTTP server, webhook receiver).

llm.local.description: May load/run a local model (weights, torch, llama.cpp).

comms.description: May send notifications/messages on the user's behalf (email, Slack).

proxy.description: May run an HTTP(S) proxy / MITM-inspection-adjacent tooling.

ram.heavy.description: May run memory-heavy jobs (model load, large indexes).

multi-host.description: May orchestrate actions on hosts other than the local machine.

probed.description: Free-form probe metadata written by the probing tool; never asserted by consumers.

probed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last probe run.

tool.description: Tool/version that produced the probe data.

machine_id.description: Opaque, non-identifying machine identifier (random id or salted hash — never a hostname, username or serial).
